edits.search: const order = await deps.paypal.createOrder(body); // BUG B1: no requestId, so a double click creates two PayPal orders
edits.replace: const order = await deps.paypal.createOrder(body, { requestId: cartId });

rationale: Pass the cart id as PayPal-Request-Id so duplicate concurrent checkouts for the same cart replay one PayPal order instead of creating two.
